name: optcatalog_play_bounce_sound
description: OptCatalog::PlayBounceSound plays a random bounce sound from the selected impact FX slot at the hit position when bounce sounds are configured.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b1030 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogRaycastHitEntry*, stack impactSlot and gainScale arguments, impactFxTable[impactSlot].bounceSoundCount gate, random index computed as (rand() * count) >> 15, selection from bounceSoundSamples, and zSndSample::PlayA3D at hitEvent->pos with null velocity.
The native smoke verifies no playback when the selected slot has zero bounce sounds and playback through zSndSample::PlayA3D when a bounce sample is configured.
